edge_cases.description: Compose with 0 or 33 sources, or an empty source key, refused before signing
Append body over 1 MiB (measured as UTF-8 bytes) refused before signing
Empty prefix for object_rename_prefix refused (would otherwise move the whole bucket)
MOVE returning 200 with per-key errors in XML is reported as failure for single-object rename
Shorter retention_time refused after the GET and before the PUT
object_compliance_set with no changes given is refused
All-digit SHA256 digest kept as text rather than converted to int
Key with spaces percent-encoded in the path-style URL
No configured secret appears in any tool output
